moods.description: You just want to laugh and have a good time. No heavy stuff.

submoods.description: Warm, broad comedy you can enjoy without paying close attention. Light, funny, leaves you smiling.
Smart humor with an edge. Jokes that make you feel a little guilty for laughing. Clever and subversive.
Fast, loud, completely unpredictable. High energy from scene one, never slows down.

moods.description: You want something that moves you. Real emotion, real tears, real human stories.

submoods.description: A deeply moving story that earns every tear. Human, honest, leaves you feeling lighter after.
Melancholic but not crushing. Bittersweet, like a song that stays with you for days.
People who pushed through impossible odds. You finish ready to do something with your life.

moods.description: Heart rate up. Action, suspense, horror — high stakes from start to finish.

submoods.description: Non-stop fights, chases, explosions. Your brain rests, your pulse doesn't.
You won't notice how tense you are until you realize you've been holding your breath.
Monsters, dread, things in the dark. Designed to make you flinch, gasp, and check your closet after.
A brilliant plan executed under pressure. Tightly plotted, very rewatchable.

moods.description: You want to use your brain. Complex plots, big ideas, films you discuss for hours after.

submoods.description: Non-linear timelines, unreliable narrators, ideas that only fully land after the credits.
Big questions, no easy answers. The real thinking happens after you close the screen.
True crime, journalists uncovering something huge, conspiracies and cover-ups.

moods.description: Low energy, no emotional demands. Gentle, comfortable, easy to watch.

submoods.description: Small stories about good people. Uplifting without being cheesy. Everything will be okay.
You're not giving this full attention and that's fine. Familiar, warm, low-stakes.
Stunning visuals of our planet. Calming and awe-inspiring simultaneously.

moods.description: Love, longing, connection. Stories about the complicated mess of loving other people.

submoods.description: Actual chemistry and tension. Not predictable — makes you feel something and talk about it after.
Crowd-pleasing, fun, holds attention even when people are chatting.
Works on two levels — kids are entertained, adults find something genuine too.

moods.description: Stories grounded in reality. The world as it actually is — beautiful, unjust, complex.

submoods.description: A window into a world completely foreign to you. The best armchair travel.
Injustice, power, systems that affect real people. Uncomfortable and necessary.
Artists, pioneers, people who changed things. The true story is always stranger.

moods.description: It is late. You want something moody, cinematic, or dreamlike. Style over plot.

submoods.description: Hard-boiled, rain-soaked, morally grey. Jazz, shadows, cities at night.
Logic is not the point. You experience these films more than you understand them.
Space, the future, the improbability of existence. You finish feeling small in the best way.
